task: Chat with a small language model privately on this computer
packaging_note: Unmodified Open WebUI and Ollama images. A first-use download retrieves the Qwen2.5 0.5B model from Ollama.

access.why: Ollama downloads the model on first use. Chat requests use the local Ollama service.

known_issues: The first start downloads about 400 MB of model data as well as the two app images. CPU responses take longer than hosted chat.
Single-user, no login. Chat history and models are stored in local Docker volumes.
